title: TrendPullback Momentum Confirmation Validation
question: Does stronger causal pre-entry momentum distinguish TrendPullback entries that achieve meaningful favorable excursion from weak losing entries?

groups.weak: observed MFE < 2.0% and final net return < 0

rules: Use the same observed historical entries; do not alter entry timestamps or prices.
Use only fully completed candles before entry; exclude any candle whose close time is after the entry timestamp.
Treat momentum as continuous descriptive evidence first; do not choose a cutoff from this sample.
Compare weak versus confirmed-move groups and report counterexamples.
Do not modify production strategy code.
Do not tune thresholds after seeing results.
If causal candle reconstruction or comparison-group evidence is insufficient, return BLOCKED-EVIDENCE.
